Simulated input outages for controlled experiments

tl_simulate_outages.Rd

Places non-overlapping outages in each record and removes the affected prediction time, so that tl_ledger() marks it as "no_input". Every row produced carries a reason starting with "simulated"; results from these experiments must be labelled as simulated.

Usage

tl_simulate_outages(ledger, n, duration,
  mode = c("random", "event_concentrated"), seed = NULL, max_tries = 1000)

Arguments

ledger

A tl_ledger (used for records, reference and predictions).

n

Number of outages per record.

duration

Duration of each outage.

mode

"random" or "event_concentrated".

seed

Optional random seed.

max_tries

Attempts per outage before giving up on a placement.

Details

mode = "random" draws outage start times uniformly over the target period. mode = "event_concentrated" is a deliberately artificial stress test: outage start times are drawn uniformly over reference event time. It tests how an evaluation behaves when missingness concentrates on events; it says nothing about whether real devices fail during events.

Value

A list with observation (for tl_ledger()) and predictions (the original prediction rows with outage time removed).

Examples

fx <- tl_fixture("acceptance")
led <- tl_ledger(fx$records, fx$reference, fx$predictions,
                 time_unit = "min")
sim <- tl_simulate_outages(led, n = 2, duration = 5, seed = 1)
sim$observation
#>   record    start       end      status                    reason
#> 1   rec1  0.00000  25.22332   available                      <NA>
#> 2   rec1 25.22332  30.22332 unavailable simulated outage (random)
#> 3   rec1 30.22332  35.35177   available                      <NA>
#> 4   rec1 35.35177  40.35177 unavailable simulated outage (random)
#> 5   rec1 40.35177 100.00000   available                      <NA>
